photo.caption: Temperature data from various scientific organizations worldwide show a high correlation regarding the progress and extent of global warming.
photo.description: Charts showing correlation of measured global average temperature, from several scientific organizations. UK Met Office source allowing download of all six datasets, adjusted to a common base value: https://climate.metoffice.cloud/temperature.html (scroll down to "Get the data / Global mean temperature") — Archive thereof: https://web.archive.org/web/20260118194423/https://climate.metoffice.cloud/temperature.html#datasets — Archive thereof: https://archive.ph/0ZAbZ Versions 14+ include SIX datasets, not just five as in earlier versions.
